title: branch-reviewer return
description: The branch-reviewer's return object, in single-pass and two-pass mode alike.

oneOf.description: The split review was written: the index and one file per finding.

index_path.description: The index path the caller supplied.

findings_dir.description: The per-finding folder, with the round suffix mirrored.

finding_count.description: The number of finding_<N>.md files written.

carried_over.description: Two-pass mode only, required there: Pass 2's real-and-missed items carried over.

skipped_covered.description: Two-pass mode only, required there: Pass 2's items skipped as already covered.

skipped_stale.description: Two-pass mode only, required there: Pass 2's items skipped as stale.

questions.description: One item per decision a finding could not take, naming the decision owed and who owes it; omitted when none.

oneOf.description: A cited input could not be read; no review file was written.

outcome.description: A cited input could not be read.

blocker.description: The unreadable path and the refusal, on one line.
